patch_description: The current batch selector promotes diversity only among proposals in the same batch. This change also measures each proposal’s distance from the high-quality scored archive, so the search can spend some LP calls exploring regions that are not already represented. It reserves part of each batch for the best surrogate-ranked moves and part for archive-novel moves, while keeping a limited shortlist for novelty selection so that extremely poor-surrogate proposals are not favored solely for being different.
